title: Cap activity input length + add rate limiting
description: No maxlength on textarea and backend only checks non-empty (functions/generate.ts:87). No rate limit/auth means scripted requests with ~150K-token inputs can run up OpenRouter cost. Fix: cap activity length server-side (added 500-char cap) + textarea maxlength. Follow-up: CF rate limiting or Turnstile on /generate.

comments.author: Carl Kibler
comments.text: DONE: 500-char cap added server-side (functions/generate.ts) returning 400, plus textarea maxlength=500. REMAINING: CF rate limiting / Turnstile on /generate to stop scripted cost amplification.
